description:
src/availability.rs:51-56: docstring for BusyPeriod.event reads 'Represented as a raw JSON value to avoid a circular type dependency: CalendarEvent is defined in a sibling module'.

There is no circular type dependency. CalendarEvent lives in src/event.rs, BusyPeriod lives in src/availability.rs; both are sibling modules in the same crate, neither depends on the other. Using Option<serde_json::Value> would be perfectly fine if it were a typed Option<crate::CalendarEvent>; the only constraint is that it would force consumers of BusyPeriod to also know about the full CalendarEvent type. The real reason is wire-format flexibility (the spec says event is 'a CalendarEvent restricted to a subset of fields' and the restriction is server-defined).

Fix: replace 'to avoid a circular type dependency' with the real rationale, e.g.: 'Represented as a raw JSON value because the server may return only a subset of CalendarEvent fields per draft §2.2 (event privacy and detail-access rules), and modelling that subset as a typed projection is harder than letting consumers deserialize the Value themselves when they need typed access.'

File path: crate-jmap-calendars-types/src/availability.rs:51-56
title: calendars-types: BusyPeriod.event doc cites nonexistent circular dep
